name: Wild Magic Surge 5E
description: Wild Magic Surge table (2014 Player's Handbook numbering, paraphrased). Draws get an Apply button from the Wild Surge Effects module.

results.name: Surge Every Turn
results.description: For the next minute, roll on the surge table at the start of each of your turns (ignore this result on those rolls).
results.text: Surge Every Turn. For the next minute, roll on the surge table at the start of each of your turns (ignore this result on those rolls).

results.name: See Invisibility
results.description: For the next minute you can see any invisible creature you have line of sight to.
results.text: See Invisibility. For the next minute you can see any invisible creature you have line of sight to.

results.name: Modron Companion
results.description: A modron controlled by the DM appears within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later.
results.text: Modron Companion. A modron controlled by the DM appears within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later.

results.name: Fireball on Self
results.description: You cast fireball (3rd level) centered on yourself.
results.text: Fireball on Self. You cast fireball (3rd level) centered on yourself.

results.name: Magic Missile (5th level)
results.description: You cast magic missile as a 5th-level spell.
results.text: Magic Missile (5th level). You cast magic missile as a 5th-level spell.

results.name: Height Change
results.description: Roll a d10. Your height changes by that many inches: odd shrinks you, even makes you taller.
results.text: Height Change. Roll a d10. Your height changes by that many inches: odd shrinks you, even makes you taller.

results.name: Confusion on Self
results.description: You cast confusion centered on yourself.
results.text: Confusion on Self. You cast confusion centered on yourself.

results.name: Regeneration
results.description: For the next minute, you regain 5 hit points at the start of each of your turns.
results.text: Regeneration. For the next minute, you regain 5 hit points at the start of each of your turns.

results.name: Feather Beard
results.description: You grow a long beard of feathers that stays until you sneeze, when the feathers explode from your face.
results.text: Feather Beard. You grow a long beard of feathers that stays until you sneeze, when the feathers explode from your face.

results.name: Grease on Self
results.description: You cast grease centered on yourself.
results.text: Grease on Self. You cast grease centered on yourself.

results.name: Imposing Spell
results.description: Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against the next spell you cast in the next minute that involves a saving throw.
results.text: Imposing Spell. Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against the next spell you cast in the next minute that involves a saving throw.

results.name: Blue Skin
results.description: Your skin turns a vibrant shade of blue. Remove curse can end this effect.
results.text: Blue Skin. Your skin turns a vibrant shade of blue. Remove curse can end this effect.

results.name: Third Eye
results.description: An eye appears on your forehead for the next minute, giving you advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.
results.text: Third Eye. An eye appears on your forehead for the next minute, giving you advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

results.name: Quickened Casting
results.description: For the next minute, your spells with a casting time of an action have a casting time of a bonus action.
results.text: Quickened Casting. For the next minute, your spells with a casting time of an action have a casting time of a bonus action.

results.name: Random Teleport
results.description: You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
results.text: Random Teleport. You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

results.name: Astral Plane
results.description: You are transported to the Astral Plane until the end of your next turn, then return to your space (or the nearest unoccupied one).
results.text: Astral Plane. You are transported to the Astral Plane until the end of your next turn, then return to your space (or the nearest unoccupied one).

results.name: Maximized Spell
results.description: The next damaging spell you cast within the next minute deals maximum damage on every die.
results.text: Maximized Spell. The next damaging spell you cast within the next minute deals maximum damage on every die.

results.name: Age Change
results.description: Roll a d10. Your age changes by that many years: odd makes you younger (minimum 1), even makes you older.
results.text: Age Change. Roll a d10. Your age changes by that many years: odd makes you younger (minimum 1), even makes you older.

results.name: Flumphs
results.description: 1d6 flumphs controlled by the DM appear within 60 feet of you, frightened of you, and vanish after 1 minute.
results.text: Flumphs. 1d6 flumphs controlled by the DM appear within 60 feet of you, frightened of you, and vanish after 1 minute.

results.name: Surge of Vitality
results.description: You regain 2d10 hit points.
results.text: Surge of Vitality. You regain 2d10 hit points.

results.name: Potted Plant
results.description: You turn into a potted plant until the start of your next turn: incapacitated and vulnerable to all damage. At 0 HP the pot breaks and you revert.
results.text: Potted Plant. You turn into a potted plant until the start of your next turn: incapacitated and vulnerable to all damage. At 0 HP the pot breaks and you revert.

results.name: Blink Step
results.description: For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns.
results.text: Blink Step. For the next minute, you can teleport up to 20 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns.

results.name: Levitate (Self)
results.description: You cast levitate on yourself.
results.text: Levitate (Self). You cast levitate on yourself.

results.name: Unicorn
results.description: A unicorn controlled by the DM appears within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later.
results.text: Unicorn. A unicorn controlled by the DM appears within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later.

results.name: Pink Bubbles
results.description: You can't speak for the next minute. When you try, pink bubbles float out of your mouth.
results.text: Pink Bubbles. You can't speak for the next minute. When you try, pink bubbles float out of your mouth.

results.name: Spectral Shield
results.description: A spectral shield hovers near you for the next minute: +2 bonus to AC and immunity to magic missile.
results.text: Spectral Shield. A spectral shield hovers near you for the next minute: +2 bonus to AC and immunity to magic missile.

results.name: Sober Spell
results.description: You are immune to being intoxicated by alcohol for the next 5d6 days.
results.text: Sober Spell. You are immune to being intoxicated by alcohol for the next 5d6 days.

results.name: Hair Loss
results.description: Your hair falls out but grows back within 24 hours.
results.text: Hair Loss. Your hair falls out but grows back within 24 hours.

results.name: Burning Touch
results.description: For the next minute, flammable (nonmagical) objects you touch that nobody else is wearing or carrying burst into flame.
results.text: Burning Touch. For the next minute, flammable (nonmagical) objects you touch that nobody else is wearing or carrying burst into flame.

results.name: Regain Spell Slot
results.description: You regain your lowest-level expended spell slot.
results.text: Regain Spell Slot. You regain your lowest-level expended spell slot.

results.name: Shouting
results.description: For the next minute, you must shout when you speak.
results.text: Shouting. For the next minute, you must shout when you speak.

results.name: Fog Cloud on Self
results.description: You cast fog cloud centered on yourself.
results.text: Fog Cloud on Self. You cast fog cloud centered on yourself.

results.name: Lightning Strike
results.description: Up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet of you take 4d10 lightning damage.
results.text: Lightning Strike. Up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet of you take 4d10 lightning damage.

results.name: Spooked
results.description: You are frightened until the end of your next turn (the DM picks the source).
results.text: Spooked. You are frightened until the end of your next turn (the DM picks the source).

results.name: Mass Invisibility
results.description: Each creature within 30 feet of you becomes invisible for the next minute; it ends on a creature when it attacks or casts a spell.
results.text: Mass Invisibility. Each creature within 30 feet of you becomes invisible for the next minute; it ends on a creature when it attacks or casts a spell.

results.name: Resilience
results.description: You have resistance to all damage for the next minute.
results.text: Resilience. You have resistance to all damage for the next minute.

results.name: Surge Poison
results.description: A random creature within 60 feet of you is poisoned for 1d4 hours.
results.text: Surge Poison. A random creature within 60 feet of you is poisoned for 1d4 hours.

results.name: Radiant Glow
results.description: You shed bright light in a 30-foot radius for the next minute. A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you is blinded until the end of its next turn.
results.text: Radiant Glow. You shed bright light in a 30-foot radius for the next minute. A creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of you is blinded until the end of its next turn.

results.name: Polymorph (Sheep)
results.description: You cast polymorph on yourself; if you fail the save you become a sheep for the duration.
results.text: Polymorph (Sheep). You cast polymorph on yourself; if you fail the save you become a sheep for the duration.

results.name: Butterflies
results.description: Illusory butterflies (and petals) flutter in the air within 10 feet of you for the next minute.
results.text: Butterflies. Illusory butterflies (and petals) flutter in the air within 10 feet of you for the next minute.

results.name: Extra Action
results.description: You can take one additional action (this turn).
results.text: Extra Action. You can take one additional action (this turn).

results.name: Life Drain
results.description: Creatures near you take 1d10 necrotic damage and you regain hit points equal to the total dealt (2014: every creature within 30 ft; 2024: up to three you choose).
results.text: Life Drain. Creatures near you take 1d10 necrotic damage and you regain hit points equal to the total dealt (2014: every creature within 30 ft; 2024: up to three you choose).

results.name: Mirror Image
results.description: You cast mirror image.
results.text: Mirror Image. You cast mirror image.

results.name: Surge Flight
results.description: You cast fly on a random creature within 60 feet of you.
results.text: Surge Flight. You cast fly on a random creature within 60 feet of you.

results.name: Silent Invisibility
results.description: You become invisible for the next minute and other creatures can't hear you. It ends if you attack or cast a spell.
results.text: Silent Invisibility. You become invisible for the next minute and other creatures can't hear you. It ends if you attack or cast a spell.

results.name: Second Life
results.description: If you die within the next minute, you come back to life as if by the reincarnate spell.
results.text: Second Life. If you die within the next minute, you come back to life as if by the reincarnate spell.

results.name: Growth
results.description: Your size increases by one size category for the next minute.
results.text: Growth. Your size increases by one size category for the next minute.

results.name: Piercing Vulnerability
results.description: You and each creature within 30 feet of you are vulnerable to piercing damage for the next minute.
results.text: Piercing Vulnerability. You and each creature within 30 feet of you are vulnerable to piercing damage for the next minute.

results.name: Ethereal Music
results.description: You are surrounded by faint, ethereal music for the next minute.
results.text: Ethereal Music. You are surrounded by faint, ethereal music for the next minute.

results.name: Font Refilled
results.description: You regain all expended sorcery points.
results.text: Font Refilled. You regain all expended sorcery points.
